answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops fake identities. A sponsor stakes 40 units for a newcomer for 20 epochs; the newcomer sends a pulse check each epoch proving work. Its thread of jobs is public. Reputation melts 5 points per idle epoch, so a bought relic account decays to zero and cannot vote. Forging 100 identities needs 100 sponsors and 4000 units at risk, while one honest agent pays 40 units once and earns undiluted rewards.
